_comment: Prefab model library. Every model is assembled from primitives + curves by library.place. offsets/points are meters, rotations radians, origin = ground centre, +Z up.

campfire.description: Stone-ring campfire: 3 crossed logs, glowing embers and 19 curved, tapered flame tongues in 3 layers (deep red-orange outside, orange in the middle, yellow core) plus a warm orange point light.

torch.description: Hand torch: wooden stick, cloth wrap, 4 curved flame tongues and a warm point light.

lantern.description: Glowing lantern: base, cap, emissive glass, curved bezier handle and a warm point light.

pine_tree.description: Low-poly pine tree: trunk plus 3 stacked cones (about 4.3 m tall).

round_tree.description: Round-canopy tree: trunk, two tapered curved branches and 4 overlapping foliage blobs (about 3.7 m tall).

bush.description: Low-poly bush made of 3 overlapping blobs.

rock.description: Boulder: a large flattened rock with a smaller one leaning on it.

log_seat.description: Lying log you can sit on (about 1.4 m long).

stool.description: Folding camp stool: blue seat and 4 thin metal legs.

tent.description: A-frame camping tent made of real flat panels: blue/green slopes, two closed triangular ends and a floor, with two guy ropes (curves) and stakes. Sits flat on the ground, no ground plane needed.

fence.description: 2 m wooden fence segment (3 posts, 2 rails). Place several side by side to make a longer fence.

street_lamp.description: Street lamp: pole, curved bezier arm, glowing bulb and a warm-white point light (about 3.9 m tall).

cloud.description: Puffy cloud made of 4 overlapping spheres. Place it high (z around 8-10) for a sky.
